name: RunEventScript04
notes: Discovered via compiler twins (--min 16 --max-diff 8): a relocation-masked 7-core-byte match against the exact sibling resource_3aa:0200140c (ConfigureFourSceneChannelsAndHandoff, games/gs1/src/overlays/scene_channel/configure_four_scene_channels_and_handoff.c). Every callee in this owner is that sibling's callee shifted by a uniform +0x44 (Func_02002ec4->02002f08, 02002f4e->02002f92, 02002f5a->02002f9e, 02002f66->02002faa, 02002f72->02002fb6), confirming this is a parallel scene block one region over.

Unlike the template (which configures four channels with four DIFFERENT values 0x6000/0xe000/0x2000/0xa000), this owner configures all four channels to the SAME value 0xc000. The reference reloads the 0xc000 immediate fresh at each of the four call sites (movs r1,#192; lsls r1,r1,#8 repeated); the candidate's compiler CSEs the four identical-valued loads into one shared register, costing 4 bytes and reshaping every following instruction's register numbering.
Recovered only from the retained owner bytes in the approved local ROM, the byte-exact sibling source, in-repository headers, and the approved compiler.
This candidate claims zero DONE bytes.
